coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping (night owl, late bedtime); air conditioner running for the heatwave night
Waking up slowly and completing daily stretching routine on the floor mat
Showering and washing with hot water, brushing teeth (Bathroom free after Member 1's 06:30-07:00 wash)
Cooking a diet-restriction-friendly breakfast and brewing strong coffee with the kettle (after Member 1 has finished breakfast and left for work)
Eating breakfast while reading scripture and journaling devotional notes
Setting up desk lamp and monitor, reviewing client files and the day's telehealth schedule
Conducting remote telehealth therapy sessions and writing clinical documentation
Cooking and eating a simple lunch that respects the medical dietary restriction
Resting indoors away from the heatwave, doing light stretching and eye rest
Refilling water bottle and making another coffee
Afternoon telehealth consultations, case notes, and preparation for clinical supervision
Tidying the living area, vacuuming, and playing quiet music in the background
Cooking dinner from scratch using the induction cooker and rice cooker; Member 1 joins at 18:00 to help with cooking dinner (joint activity)
Eating dinner with Member 1 while listening to music on the phone (joint activity)
Cleaning up the counter and loading the dishwasher together with Member 1 (joint activity)
Watching TV with Member 1 to unwind (joint activity)
Daily stretching and gentle mobility work adapted for reduced manual dexterity
Sketching and drawing with music playing
Personal journaling and evening prayer and reflection
Streaming YouTube videos and replying to messages on WhatsApp
Making a low-caffeine herbal tea and preparing tomorrow's meals
Night washing up and brushing teeth (after Member 1's 22:00-22:30 evening wash)
Winding down with a book, turning off the light at midnight to sleep
